WITH status_averages AS (
  SELECT t.equipstatus, AVG(s.pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse_rate
  FROM signals AS s
  JOIN telescopes AS t
    ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
  WHERE s.pulsepersec IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY t.equipstatus
), first_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_rate
  FROM status_averages
), first_kept AS (
  SELECT sa.equipstatus, sa.avg_pulse_rate,
         sa.avg_pulse_rate - fm.mean_rate AS excess_first
  FROM status_averages AS sa
  CROSS JOIN first_mean AS fm
  WHERE sa.avg_pulse_rate > fm.mean_rate
), second_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_rate
  FROM first_kept
), remaining AS (
  SELECT fk.avg_pulse_rate, fk.excess_first,
         fk.avg_pulse_rate - sm.mean_rate AS excess_second
  FROM first_kept AS fk
  CROSS JOIN second_mean AS sm
  WHERE fk.avg_pulse_rate > sm.mean_rate
)
SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS avg_remaining_status_pulse_rate,
       AVG(excess_first) AS avg_excess_over_first_mean,
       AVG(excess_second) AS avg_excess_over_second_mean
FROM remaining;

assumptions.assumption: Each distinct equipment status with at least one non-null pulse rate contributes equally to the means; null equipment statuses form one status group.
